blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines—Cebu is set to witness a historic moment in Philippine basketball as Gilas Pilipinas brings its FIBA Basketball World Cup 2027 Asian Qualifiers home games to the newly built SM Seaside Arena. The February-March 2027 qualifying window will mark the first time Gilas Pilipinas plays a home game in Cebu and the first International Basketball Federation (FIBA) game outside Manila. Samahang Basketbol ng Pilipinas (SBP) Executive Director Erika Dy confirmed the development on Tuesday, September 29. SBP Zone 8 Regional Director Popoy Navarro also confirmed the news to Cebu media.
